title: 上昇姿勢の埋込型ドックレベラー
description: 倉庫荷捌き床に埋め込むデッキとリップの静的ユニット。上昇した縞鋼板風デッキ、前端リップと連続ピン・分割ヒンジ、下面の縦横補強、基礎フレーム、側面板、実形状の昇降リンクとシリンダー外観を造形。周囲ピット、床、建物、ドックシェルター、トラック、人や荷物は含みません。最下部フレームを基準に配置し、周囲床や車両高さは別途シーンで合わせる必要があります。隠れた油圧系統、動力源、内部機構、細かなねじ山は省略。固定姿勢のみで作動・衝突・荷重評価はなく、機械安全・人の利用・建築基準への適合は未検証。施工・操作案内ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.310 × 0.983 × 2.859 m、40,260三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: Static recessed warehouse dock deck-and-lip unit in a raised pose, with actual raised checker details, front lip, continuous pivot pins and segmented hinges, underside longitudinal/cross ribs, base frame, side toe guards, visible pinned lifting linkage and a cylinder appearance assembly. No surrounding pit, floor, building, dock shelter, truck, person or cargo is included. Place from the lowest support frame and align surrounding floor/vehicle heights separately. Hidden hydraulic circuit, power unit, internal mechanisms and tiny screw threads are omitted. Fixed pose only, without operation, collisions, load rating or machinery, human-use and building-standard validation. This is not installation or operating guidance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.310 × 0.983 × 2.859 m; 40,260 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
